name: build-payment-readiness
job: Build production payments: providers, ledger, webhooks, entitlement projection, reconciliation, and finance close.

inScope: Provider authority and readback for confirmations, refunds, disputes, chargebacks
Idempotent ledger ingestion and entitlement projection
Settlement, reconciliation, finance close, and rollback controls
Webhook outage ingestion, replay, and dead-letter handling
outOfScope: Customer messaging, grace, repayment, and account consequences (refund-and-support-flow)
Granting durable value from client-only confirmation

inputs: Payment channel, product type, and billing model
Provider identifiers, catalog mapping, and entitlement semantics
Refund/dispute policy, settlement/fee model, and reconciliation owner
outputs: Payment state model, ledger schema, and event precedence rules
Reconciliation plan with numeric tolerances, owners, and close blockers
Release gates with fixture, dashboard/alert, rollback path, and approval evidence

tools: provider sandbox and live testing environments
data: current official provider, tax, and platform requirements
permissions: provider API credentials owned by the payment operator

failureSemantics: No durable value from client-only confirmation; corrective ledger events append and replay rather than silently editing entitlements; payments never ship without fee, tax, settlement, invoice, refund, dispute, and entitlement reconciliation evidence.

outcome.observable: Payments, entitlements, and refunds reconcile against provider truth with replayable ledger events, named finance-close owners and tolerances, and release gates carrying fixture, alert, rollback, and approval evidence.
